<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Institutional flows:</strong> Domestic Institutional Investors (DIIs) have provided a critical buffer for Indian equities, investing 347% more than the Rs 1.81 lakh crore sold by FIIs in FY26, helping maintain market stability despite recent selling streaks.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxNcGlPV0NIc2R1SExQdGxfc09ROTNJcVFUdWJhM0MzNFBhbkZLUWF1QU0xNkx3LVBxdWN3TFRtNGNRZlNKZS1zNFdZLXRIUzNpdHd5VHFuREhRQWRyYTM5QVNfY2NsVGhEeEdoSksydjNfSDlqNm1pREhWQXFQLXRJemFvUktvSjlxWG81bkdWcVIzbjdCb3B2RXc2UXJzc1o0R0EwYzcxd0FRLUtDcWxfNm1KYw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Trade deficit impact:</strong> India’s goods trade deficit has reached a six-month high, driven by rising import costs linked to ongoing Middle East conflicts, which continues to weigh on the rupee and market sentiment.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Geopolitical and macro headwinds:</strong> Indian markets remain cautious as global indices face pressure from rising bond yields and elevated crude oil prices, with West Asia tensions contributing to a second consecutive weekly decline for the Nifty.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W11</a></span></li>
</ul>
